name: MJ Lenderman
label: Anti-
lede: MJ Lenderman scooped ice cream in Asheville, played lead guitar for Wednesday, and put out the record Pitchfork ranked No. 4 of 2024.

eras.title: A kid from Asheville with a sticker-covered Squier
eras.text: Mark Jacob Lenderman, known to everyone as Jake, grows up in Asheville, North Carolina, takes up guitar young, and falls in with the UNC Asheville house-show crowd. Wednesday starts in the same scene before he joins.

years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · The Ringer: MJ Lenderman, Indie Rock's No. 1 Prospect · Guitar.com: How MJ Lenderman embraced exploding guitar solos · Indy Week: Interview: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Guitar Hero at seven, then a rock camp
years.p: Mark Jacob Lenderman is born in Asheville in February 1999; his parents had moved there from Virginia in 1993. The game led to lessons.
years.xp:
His first guitar was a sticker-covered sunburst Squier Stratocaster, he told Guitar.com, and at nine or ten he found [[Dinosaur Jr.|77c167d2-4965-4421-830a-9815e4956475]] through his father's copy of Farm. At rock camp he met Ethan Baechtold, later Wednesday's bassist.

He played basketball hard through middle school and early high school, until he lost interest in coaches who, in his words, "tried to beat you down." The sport never left his songs.

years.src: Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals
years.h: Karly Hartzman starts Wednesday as a solo project
years.p: It becomes a duo with Daniel Gorham on the self-released yep definitely (January 31, 2018).
years.xp:
The lineup came together in the house-show scene around UNC Asheville, where Hartzman, who grew up in Greensboro, met Lenderman, drummer Alan Miller and pedal steel player Xandy Chelmis, according to The Ringer.

Wikipedia lists Gorham as leaving in 2019 for Prince Daddy & the Hyena.

eras.title: Scoops, Bandcamp and a Wednesday guitar
eras.text: Lenderman scoops ice cream, posts lo-fi records on Bandcamp, and becomes Wednesday's lead guitarist. By spring 2022 a Dear Life Records album full of wrestlers and hangovers is on year-end lists.

years.big: "It's the only job I could tour with."
years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Is Knockin' On Rock Stardom's Door
years.h: The self-titled debut goes up on Bandcamp; the ice cream job stays
years.p: MJ Lenderman came out June 15, 2019 on Bandcamp and Dear Life Records, the Asheville label that would release his next three solo albums. He told Stereogum why he kept scooping.
years.xp: He had worked at an ice cream shop since high school and kept the job into his twenties.

years.src: Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals · Variety: Wednesday Singer Karly Hartzman
years.h: Lenderman tours with Wednesday just before shows stop
years.p: He joined Wednesday on the road in early 2020. By Twin Plagues (August 13, 2021, Orindal Records) he was a full member.
years.xp:
Sources disagree on the start date: Wikipedia's Wednesday page dates his tenure from 2020, while his own page says 2018. The Ringer has him a full member by Twin Plagues.

Hartzman told Variety how the trade worked: he writes his guitar parts for Wednesday, and he teaches her guitar parts for his songs.

years.src: Wikipedia: Ghost of Your Guitar Solo
years.h: Ghost of Your Guitar Solo grows out of daily writing with housemates
years.p: Released March 26, 2021 on Dear Life: ten songs in 25 minutes. Colin Miller and Lewis Dahm play on the closer, "Live Jack."
years.xp:
Wikipedia says the record started as daily writing exercises and jam sessions with his housemates, then got sanded down into songs. Vinyl and CD followed in May 2023, with cover art by Jon Samuels, after the live album sent listeners back to it.

It opens with its longest track, the 4:45 title song, and several tracks in the middle run under two minutes.

q: The less people hear me talk, the more they can project on me.
years.src: Wikipedia: Boat Songs · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Indy Week: Interview: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Word of mouth carries Boat Songs onto the year-end lists
years.p: Released April 29, 2022 on Dear Life and recorded at Drop of Sun with Alex Farrar. Pitchfork's Sasha Geffen gave it 8.3.
years.xp:
Two singles set it up: "Hangover Game" in January and "TLC Cage Match" in March. Stereogum's Chris DeVille compared him to Jason Molina, Uncle Tupelo and Pinegrove. The record landed on year-end lists at Pitchfork, the A.V. Club, Rolling Stone and The Ringer, and placed as high as No. 4 on The Alternative's top 50.

He kept his distance from the hype.

years.cap: Karly Hartzman with Wednesday, Pittsburgh, January 2024
years.src: Wikipedia: Bull Believer · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band)
years.h: Wednesday sign to Dead Oceans on the last day of recording
years.p: "Bull Believer," Hartzman's 8:30 song about bullfighting and addiction, was recorded at Drop of Sun and released September 8, 2022.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says the first half draws on a Cocaine & Rhinestones episode about George Jones and bullfighting, and the second half on Hartzman's memory of a friend who died when she was seventeen. She has said it was about the third time she had screamed in her life; the rest of the band played Tetris in another part of the studio during the take.

Pitchfork put it at No. 92 on its 2022 best songs list.

eras.title: Anti- picks him up
eras.text: Anti- signs him with help from a Crutchfield, Wednesday's Rat Saw God comes out on Dead Oceans, and a live album records what the band sounds like onstage.

years.big: "Like talking to somebody who was already a friend"
years.src: Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Is Knockin' On Rock Stardom's Door · NME: MJ Lenderman on resisting the hype · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Allison Crutchfield is why he signs with Anti-
years.p: That is how Lenderman described the label's A&R, Allison Crutchfield, sister of [[Waxahatchee|42321e24-42b6-4f08-b0d9-8325ee887a20]]'s Katie Crutchfield, when he told Stereogum why he chose Anti-.
years.xp:
Boat Songs had done the work: Wikipedia's account has him signing to Anti- in 2022 after the record's reception. NME notes the Crutchfield link and quotes him calling the team "really open and understanding."

Dear Life Records had put out his first three solo albums; Anti- has handled everything since.

years.cap: Karly Hartzman and Wednesday, Grand Rapids, Michigan, 2023
years.src: The Ringer: Wednesday's Teenage Dirtbag Hymnals · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: Bull Believer
years.h: Rat Saw God puts Hartzman's high school on Dead Oceans
years.p: Released April 7, 2023. Hartzman wrote from her own memories and local legends; Lenderman supplied the lead guitar.
years.xp:
The Ringer reported that Hartzman got permission from the people whose stories she used, including her uncle. "Chosen to Deserve" is about the two bandmates' own relationship, and "Formula One" is about their pandemic rituals.

At Primavera Sound Barcelona on June 4, 2023, Hartzman gave an anti-Amazon speech before "Bull Believer," which she dedicated to mistreated warehouse workers.

years.cap: Lenderman on guitar with Wednesday, Grand Rapids, Michigan, 2023
years.src: Wikipedia: And the Wind (Live and Loose!) · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
yt: Full set at Pitchfork Music Festival, 2023
years.h: His first release for Anti- is a live album
years.p: And the Wind (Live and Loose!) came out November 17, 2023: 15 songs from Lincoln Hall in Chicago and the Lodge Room in Los Angeles. Metacritic has it at 82.
years.xp:
The Chicago show was a Pitchfork Music Festival afterparty. Pitchfork's Arielle Gordon wrote that he turns his dreamlike narratives into something "joyous, collective, and free."

The band behind him, the Wind, is Colin Miller on drums, Landon George on bass, Xandy Chelmis on pedal steel, Ethan Baechtold on keys and Jon Samuels on guitar.

eras.title: Manning Fireworks
eras.text: A 38-minute record made at Drop of Sun, the Asheville studio where Wednesday and Indigo De Souza also record, and a hurricane that hits the same month.

years.src: Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Year-End Lists: Pitchfork 50 Best Albums of 2024
yt: "She's Leaving You" with Waxahatchee, Nashville, Sept 2024
years.h: Lenderman sings and plays on Waxahatchee's Tigers Blood
years.p: He's on Katie Crutchfield's album and on the single "Right Back to It." Pitchfork ranked Tigers Blood No. 6 of 2024, two spots behind his own record.
years.xp:
Crutchfield's sister Allison is the A&R person who signed him to Anti-. In September 2024 Crutchfield joined him onstage in Nashville for "She's Leaving You," at the Basement East.

In March, Wikipedia reports, he and Hartzman ended their six-year relationship while touring in Tokyo. The news became public in July. They kept working together, and Hartzman sings backing vocals on "She's Leaving You."

years.src: Wikipedia: She's Leaving You · NPR: MJ Lenderman joins rock and roll's lineage of heartbreak kids
years.h: The "She's Leaving You" video is a talent show with cheerleaders and magicians
years.p: The lead single came out June 24, 2024, with a video by Clay Tatum and Whitmer Thomas.
years.xp:
Critics compared the video to "Smells Like Teen Spirit" and the film Drop Dead Gorgeous. Wikipedia describes the song as a tragicomic portrait of a man caught lying after a bender in Vegas.

NPR's review of the album said the record came out of a hard year in which both the band and Lenderman's solo star were on the rise.

years.cap: Lenderman at the Roundhouse, London, August 15, 2025
years.src: Wikipedia: Manning Fireworks · Guitar.com: How MJ Lenderman embraced exploding guitar solos · Wikipedia: MJ Lenderman
years.h: Manning Fireworks closes with ten minutes of "Bark at the Moon"
years.p: Nine songs, released September 6, 2024 on Anti-. Pitchfork's Jeremy D. Larson gave it 8.7 and Best New Music, then ranked it No. 4 of 2024 behind Cindy Lee, Charli XCX and Jessica Pratt.
years.xp:
Lenderman and Alex Farrar produced it at Drop of Sun Studios in Asheville, where he played guitar, bass, drums, organ and drone. He told Guitar.com he was thinking about hooks and direct melodies this time; the exploding guitar solos on "Wristwatch," "On My Knees" and "Rudolph" he called "kind of an explosion."

Hartzman, Chelmis and Baechtold of Wednesday are on it, plus Landon George, Shane McCord on clarinet and Colin Miller on slide guitar. Singles: "She's Leaving You," "Joker Lips" (July 29) and "Wristwatch" (September 4).

Metacritic has it at 88. The New Yorker named it the best album of 2024. Pitchfork's December 3 list also had Nala Sinephro, Waxahatchee, Mount Eerie, Bladee, Astrid Sonne and Kim Gordon in the top 10. Stereogum, Brooklyn Vegan and The Line of Best Fit put it second. Rolling Stone and Pitchfork had it in their top five, Wikipedia reports.

years.src: Stereogum: MJ Lenderman Postpones Tour Dates · WUNC: Why Asheville's Drop of Sun Studios · Wikipedia: Manning Fireworks
years.h: Hurricane Helene floods western North Carolina and the tour openers move
years.p: The Manning Fireworks kickoff in Atlanta and Nashville was postponed. Most of the band and their families live in the flooded region.
years.xp:
Stereogum reported the first show moved to Knoxville that Sunday. Indigo De Souza, who also lives near Asheville, wrote that her house was completely flooded.

Drop of Sun, where the record was made, later helped raise $145,000 in artist grants through the nonprofit Lamplight AVL, according to WUNC. Lenderman was one of 135 artists on a hurricane-relief compilation.

eras.title: Off the road, still in the band
eras.text: Lenderman steps back from touring with Wednesday, plays late-night TV with the Wind, and turns up in a surprise band with the Crutchfield sisters.

years.src: Consequence: MJ Lenderman Brings Joker Lips to Kimmel · Wikipedia: Wednesday (American band) · Wikipedia: Bleeds (Wednesday album)
years.h: Jimmy Kimmel Live! gets "Joker Lips"; Wednesday gets a touring hiatus
years.p: On February 12, 2025, Lenderman and the Wind played the song in front of a backdrop of the album's hand-painted art.
years.xp:
Consequence reported he added eye rolls for lyrics that could not be sung on network TV. His NPR Tiny Desk set had gone up on January 29.

Also in February, Wikipedia reports, he announced he would step back from touring with Wednesday while remaining "a full contributing member" in the studio. Jake "Spyder" Pugh has filled in on lead guitar on the road. Wednesday's Bleeds (September 19, 2025, Dead Oceans, produced by Alex Farrar at Drop of Sun) still features Lenderman.

years.cap: Lenderman at the Roundhouse, London, August 15, 2025
years.h: Snocaps shows up on Halloween with no warning
years.p: Katie and Allison Crutchfield, Brad Cook and Lenderman released a self-titled debut on Anti- on October 31, 2025.
years.xp: It is the Crutchfield sisters' first joint album since their P.S. Eliot days, and Wikipedia credits Lenderman as a full member. Reviewers called it headstrong, tender Americana.
